#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;

class FFT {
public:
    static const int MAX_K = 21;
    static const int MAX_N = 1 << MAX_K;
    static double wR[MAX_N], wI[MAX_N], rR[MAX_N], rI[MAX_N], aR[MAX_N], aI[MAX_N];
    static int n, k, lastK;
    static int bitReverse[MAX_N];

    static void performFFT(bool inverse) {
        if (lastK != k) {
            lastK = k;
            bitReverse[0] = 0;
            for (int i = 1, group = -1; i < n; i++) {
                if ((i & (i - 1)) == 0) group++;
                bitReverse[i] = bitReverse[i ^ (1 << group)] ^ (1 << (k - 1 - group));
            }
            wR[1] = 1;
            wI[1] = 0;
            for (int t = 0; t < k - 1; t++) {
                double angle = M_PI / n * (1 << (k - 1 - t));
                double cosVal = cos(angle);
                double sinVal = sin(angle);
                int p2 = 1 << t;
                int p3 = p2 << 1;
                for (int j = p2, idx = j * 2; j < p3; j++, idx += 2) {
                    wR[idx] = wR[j];
                    wI[idx] = wI[j];
                    wR[idx + 1] = wR[j] * cosVal - wI[j] * sinVal;
                    wI[idx + 1] = wR[j] * sinVal + wI[j] * cosVal;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int rev = bitReverse[i];
            if (i < rev) {
                double temp = aR[i];
                aR[i] = aR[rev];
                aR[rev] = temp;
                temp = aI[i];
                aI[i] = aI[rev];
                aI[rev] = temp;
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) aI[i] = -aI[i];
        }
        for (int len = 1; len < n; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                int wIndex = len;
                for (int it = 0, j = i + len; it < len; it++, i++, j++) {
                    double realPart = aR[j] * wR[wIndex] - aI[j] * wI[wIndex];
                    double imagPart = aR[j] * wI[wIndex] + aI[j] * wR[wIndex];
                    wIndex++;
                    aR[j] = aR[i] - realPart;
                    aI[j] = aI[i] - imagPart;
                    aR[i] += realPart;
                    aI[i] += imagPart;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static vector<long long> multiply(vector<long long>& first, vector<long long>& second) {
        int len1 = first.size(), len2 = second.size();
        for (k = 0, n = 1; n < len1 + len2 - 1; n <<= 1, k++) {}
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            aR[i] = (i < len1) ? first[i] : 0;
            aI[i] = (i < len2) ? second[i] : 0;
        }
        performFFT(false);
        aR[n] = aR[0];
        aI[n] = aI[0];
        double factor = -1.0 / n / 4.0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= n - i; i++) {
            double real1 = aR[i] * aR[i] - aI[i] * aI[i];
            double imag1 = aR[i] * aI[i] * 2;
            double real2 = aR[n - i] * aR[n - i] - aI[n - i] * aI[n - i];
            double imag2 = aR[n - i] * aI[n - i] * -2;
            double newReal = -imag1 + imag2;
            double newImag = real1 - real2;
            aR[i] = newReal * factor;
            aI[i] = newImag * factor;
            aR[n - i] = aR[i];
            aI[n - i] = -aI[i];
        }
        performFFT(true);
        vector<long long> result(len1 + len2 - 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < result.size(); i++) {
            result[i] = llround(aR[i]) % MOD;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static vector<long long> multiplyPrecise(vector<long long>& first, vector<long long>& second) {
        long long sqrtMod = (long long)sqrt(MOD);
        vector<long long> aLow(first.size());
        vector<long long> aHigh(first.size());
        vector<long long> bLow(second.size());
        vector<long long> bHigh(second.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < first.size(); i++) {
            aLow[i] = first[i] % sqrtMod;
            aHigh[i] = first[i] / sqrtMod;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < second.size(); i++) {
            bLow[i] = second[i] % sqrtMod;
            bHigh[i] = second[i] / sqrtMod;
        }
        vector<long long> r11 = multiply(aLow, bLow);
        vector<long long> r12 = multiply(aLow, bHigh);
        vector<long long> r21 = multiply(aHigh, bLow);
        vector<long long> r22 = multiply(aHigh, bHigh);
        vector<long long> result(r11.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < result.size(); i++) {
            result[i] = ((sqrtMod * sqrtMod % MOD) * r22[i] % MOD +
                        (sqrtMod * ((r12[i] + r21[i]) % MOD)) % MOD +
                        r11[i]) % MOD;
        }
        return result;
    }
};

// Static member definitions
double FFT::wR[FFT::MAX_N], FFT::wI[FFT::MAX_N], FFT::rR[FFT::MAX_N], FFT::rI[FFT::MAX_N], FFT::aR[FFT::MAX_N], FFT::aI[FFT::MAX_N];
int FFT::n, FFT::k, FFT::lastK = -1;
int FFT::bitReverse[FFT::MAX_N];

vector<long long> exponentiate(vector<long long>& base, long long exp) {
    if (exp == 1) return base;
    if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
        return FFT::multiplyPrecise(base, exponentiate(base, exp - 1));
    }
    vector<long long> half = exponentiate(base, exp >> 1);
    return FFT::multiplyPrecise(half, half);
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    vector<long long> base(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx;
        cin >> idx;
        base[idx] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<long long> res = exponentiate(base, n / 2);
    long long total = 0;
    for (long long val : res) {
        total = (total + (val * val) % MOD) % MOD;
    }
    cout << total << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
